TEXT:
[FI] Ever since her slap, Kuroneko cut off all contact. No 
matter how many times I called, there was no sign that 
she wanted to meet. It's tough for me to visit her too.

[FI] Thereafter, wanting to understand Kuroneko more, 
I wore only black and watched her favorite anime.

[FI] I felt that if I imitated her, I may be able to 
understand what she's thinking. I even started to 
speak Chuunibyou.

[FI] At first it was really strange, but I got used to 
Chuunibyou speech eventually. In a blink of an eye, 
Fall has already passed.
[FI] And with that, several months had passed.
[FI] Today, I head to my holy grounds yet again.

[FI] The building filled with noisy games. Faint illumination. Unable 
to discard the memories of my time with Kuroneko, I actively 
avoid a solution, so this is the most suitable place for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Heh.

[FI] I can't help but smile, my spiritual energy gushes 
forth.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hehehe... I can feel it... The presence of darkness...

[FI] This place filled with darkness and miasma, I feel it 
becoming my energy. I walk to the fighting game 
section.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Oh hey, Kyousuke-kun. You have finally come to this 
world too, huh...

[FI] On the way, I met someone who was unmistakably 
my former soulmate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Fate-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] I welcome you... to this den for losers who were 
consumed by the darkness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Heh... Loser? No. Right now, I have become the 
Prince of Darkness... This darkness is where I belong...

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Okay, well, that all aside, you seem to have 
changed quite a bit. How regrettable.

[FI] Honestly, she's the only one I didn't want to hear 
that from, but... Whatever. We're on the same boat 
now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is today the period of harvest as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. I'm close to getting reaping my 
rewards... [font_size=28]Witness my skill...![/font_size]

[FI] Fate's eyes seethed with ambition while walking 
towards the hunting grounds (slot machine corner).
[FI] I should be heading towards my battlefield as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll claim this spot today.

[FI] With loads of money and time, I embarked on the 
warrior's (gamer) journey, alone.

[FI] That said, I'm still far from the ranks of the elite. 
But it's fine. Right now, I have all the time in the 
world.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Now then, how far can I hold out today...
[FI] Game Start. Game Over. Insert Coin.
[FI] I endlessly repeat this chain of actions.

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT: [FI] Here again? I welcome you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Cut the pleasantries and let us begin. Darker than 
the still of midnight, the devil's banquet...

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT: [FI] Of course. I'm going to win today!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hmph, tremble before the presence of my Dark 
Matter...!

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT:
[FI] ...Yeah, you know what, that's the kind of Chuuni I 
can't keep up with.

[FI] Perhaps it was from my regular attendance, but I 
have gained more comrades-in-arms lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT: [FI] Hey, that person there is...

[FI] I raise my head because of the commotion. There 
lies the solitary Amazoness.

[FI] I am told she is a woman of valor who had 
successfully defeated 100 people in a row.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT: [FI] How about it, have you gotten better?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, somewhat.

[FI] I don't know her name. However, I have played a 
couple of games against her.

[FI] She's as good as her brimming with confidence 
attitude leads on. I haven't won a single match 
against her.

[FI] ...Perhaps she may have been the person Kuroneko 
was searching for, but upon thinking about that, I 
hastily shook my head.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why are you so concerned about me?
[FI] That phrase was said once in my distant past.

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
[FI] Well, that timid attitude kinda reminds me of my 
little sister. If I leave you alone, I wouldn't be able 
to sleep at night.

[FI] Each time I ask, Amazoness always responds like 
that while laughing.

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, knock it off! No matter how much we 
struggle, we can't win against her!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I know. But, it's aching. My right hand's throbbing 
with the sleeping monster Cerberus...

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT:
[FI] Hmph, very well. Show me your true power, 
newborn Prince of Darkness!

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT:
[FI] ...You know, sometimes, it's just not worth it for me 
to interrupt.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well then, you too should come to this side. Give 
into your lust...!

[FI] Without a partner to react to, my words are 
ridiculous. In that case, I'll continue to fall...

SPEAKER: SPK_FAIRY
TEXT: [FI] Now, fight me with all your might! Come at me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Heh, I'll reduce you to tears today!
[FI] While sneering, I walked towards the cabinet.

[FI] That's right, I push onward. On this eternal winding 
road...

[FI] Suddenly, I asked myself "What the heck am I 
doing?", coming to my senses in a split second. But.
[FI] In a moment within the loading screen's darkness.

[FI] There lies a reflected illusion of Kuroneko with 
vacant eyes, piercing deeply into the parts of my 
heart that still remains fresh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Well, what of it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I am the beast fallen from heaven, Cerberus... The 
darkness is where I belong.
[FI] As I muttered, I insert yet another coin.
